text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having successfully coaxed her into running sprints, I fear it might be hard to convince her like this again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though I worry, my fears are assuaged when Sakura Bakushin O speaks favorably about her trust in me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Listening to her thoughts, I too gain new determination. I vow to lead her down a Bakushin Road where she can truly shine.
